fields.statement: Built rhiza from the branch head and ran `rhiza daemon install` in a scratch repo (scratch HOME, fake systemctl/loginctl on PATH, TMPDIR holding a space). The unit carried Environment="PATH=..." and Environment="TMPDIR=.../tmp dir" above ExecStart=... daemon --autonomous; a second install with the same env printed 'nothing changed' and did not daemon-reload; adding a dir to PATH rewrote the unit and called daemon-reload. A TMPDIR of `t "q" 100% \b $X` was written as `"TMPDIR=t \"q\" 100%% \\b $X"`; loading those Environment= lines into a throwaway real systemd user unit, systemctl --user show read back exactly the original value. daemon-install testscript passes.
